title: Student Transportation Services Refund Schedule: A Family's Own Cancellation of a Courtesy Rider Permit
content:
This is the Calloway Creek ISD courtesy rider permit refund schedule of Student Transportation Services under Board Policy CNA(LOCAL), for a family's own cancellation of a Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) or Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual).

**Who cancels and what the confirmation does.** Only the family cancels its courtesy rider permit: the support desk records the family's permit cancellation request, and the parent or guardian confirms the cancellation personally in the parent portal. The confirmation ends service that day, the day of confirmation being the last day of service; it completes the family's received permit cancellation request, and it posts the cancellation credit as a cancellation window credit against the permit fee, except that a cancellation credit of zero posts no credit entry.

**When the credit is fixed.** The cancellation credit is fixed only after the permit fee carries the billing correction owed for a higher meal status that took effect after the fee posted.

| On confirmation | Result |
|---|---|
| the assignment | cancelled, the day of confirmation recorded as the last day of service, closed as the family's own cancellation |
| the family's pending permit cancellation request | completed |
| a cancellation credit above zero | one cancellation window credit booked against the permit fee, dated that day; the household's amount due goes down by it |
| a cancellation credit of zero | no credit entry |

## Invocation: `confirm_permit_cancellation_9706a650`

This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_permit_cancellation_9706a650` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the parent or guardian) runs it to confirm the cancellation.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `transport_assignment_id` | the reference number of the student's transportation assignment being cancelled, as returned by the transportation assignment lookup | identifier |
| `transport_request_id` | the reference number of the family's pending permit cancellation request on that assignment, as returned by the transportation request lookup | identifier |
| `permit_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the courtesy rider permit fee entry the credit is linked to, exactly as shown on that fee in the assignment's billing history lookup; it must be a permit fee entry of the same assignment | identifier |
| `credit_amount` | the cancellation credit in US dollars | zero or a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; zero means no credit entry is posted |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the assignment reference number and its new status (cancelled), the last day of service (YYYY-MM-DD), the completed request reference number, and either the new credit entry's reference number (an opaque id beginning `tlx_`) with the credited amount in US dollars with two decimals, or that no credit entry was posted.

**Errors.** A message beginning "Error:" means nothing was changed: the credit amount was negative or had more than two decimal places; no transportation assignment has the reference number given; the request given is not a pending (received) permit cancellation request of that assignment; or the permit fee entry given is not a permit fee entry of that assignment.
